audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and level 6 read 'Skill' and two items read 'Renekton'. The packet chart — and the mirror, which reports its chart already agrees with the packet — reads Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Volibear, Renekton, Volibear. The captions on this same page already say level 6 flips to Volibear and two items are Volibear's, so the sides contradicted their own whys.

audit.why: Four spikes on the right windows: his 3-5 Fury trading, your level 6, his first item, your two items.
audit.corrected: Captions kept; the fabricated 'execute' removed from spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentioned the single most important interaction in this matchup: at 50+ Fury, Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields on the target. Volibear's entire escape pattern ends with the Sky Splitter self-shield, and his empowered W deletes it while stunning for 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Separately, 'Q-W execute' appears twice — Volibear has no execute.
audit.why: A player told to 'step out under your E shield' is being told to rely on the exact thing the empowered W removes. This is the difference between surviving the all-in and dying in it, and it was nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Ruthless Predator: 300 range, 16/14/12/10/8s, 0.75s stun — at 50+ Fury it is three slashes, destroys damage shields, and stuns 1.5s. Cull the Meek: 7s, heals him (Grievous Wounds matters, and report[8] already buys it). Slice and Dice: 450-range dash, 16s to 10s, empowered version shreds armour. Frenzied Maul is the re-bite heal, not an execute.
